basic_info.description: Elevate your city living experience in this top-floor, sun-drenched one-bedroom at The Hayes. Step into a bright, modern home featuring soaring ceilings, panoramic Cathedral Hill views, and walls of windows that fill the spacious living area with natural light. Enjoy new wood floors, a sleek kitchen with stainless steel appliances, a dedicated office nook, and a luxurious walk-in closet. Relax knowing you have in-unit laundry, secure garage parking, and exclusive building amenities: 24-hour doorperson, fitness center, and a rooftop deck with BBQ and lounge perfect for entertaining or unwinding. Live in the heart of vibrant Hayes Valley just steps from world-class dining, boutique shopping, and iconic arts venues like the SF Jazz Center, SF Symphony, and Opera House. With easy access to transit and freeways, this is the ultimate blend of comfort, convenience, and cosmopolitan lifestyle. Don't miss this unique opportunity, schedule your private tour today!
